Name: JP's Artdew Valley Vol IX - Monster Statues
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][size=6][i][color=#00ffff][u][center]Artdew Valley Vol IX[/center][/u][/color][/i][/size]
[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Because that instinct to hunt beasts is strong enough to keep their bodies as trophies, I don't like you... but I don't dislike you either.[/size][/color]

[/b]
[size=4][b][i][size=4]This mod consists of 12 volumes so far, this being the ninth of them. This volume focuses on adding 66 statues. D[/size][/i]ecorate your farm with scary monster statues and create your own museum of the monstrous history of the mines. [/b]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You can obtain all of these statues at the [color=#00ff00]Adventurers' Guild[/color] for the modest price of 1,000g each.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You can find at least 16 statues per season, so you could get them all in a year.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Of course these statues are made of wax and are not taxidermy... They are not. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]All sculptures can be placed anywhere and can be rotated to give them the best possible angle. [/size][/font]
[/list][/size][size=3]
[/size][color=#00ffff][b][i][size=3]
[/size][size=5]They are decorations and have no other function. I hope you like them![/size][/i][/b][/color]
[size=3]
[/size][size=4]
[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u][b]Translations[/b][/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000][b]you don't need to ask my permission[/b][/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]

-------------------------------------------------------------------
